package genericdisposal

import "context"

type Dependency struct{}

type Ordinary struct{}

func (Ordinary) Close() error { return nil }

type Generic struct{}

func (Generic) Close[T any]() error { return nil }

type Ambiguous struct {
	Ordinary
	Generic
}
type Shadowed struct{ Ordinary }

func (Shadowed) Close[T any]() error { return nil }

type ContextOrdinary struct{}

func (ContextOrdinary) Close(context.Context) error { return nil }

type ContextAmbiguous struct {
	ContextOrdinary
	Generic
}

type WrongArgument struct{}

func (WrongArgument) Close(int) error { return nil }

type WrongResult struct{}

func (WrongResult) Close() bool { return false }

type Variadic struct{}

func (Variadic) Close(...context.Context) error { return nil }

type PointerReceiver struct{}

func (*PointerReceiver) Close() error { return nil }

type FieldShadowed struct {
	Ordinary
	Close int
}
type Left struct{ Ordinary }
type Right struct{ Ordinary }
type OrdinaryAmbiguous struct {
	Left
	Right
}

func NewAmbiguous(*Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency) Ambiguous {
	panic("not executed")
}
func NewShadowed(*Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency) Shadowed {
	panic("not executed")
}
func NewContextAmbiguous(context.Context, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency) ContextAmbiguous {
	panic("not executed")
}
func NewGeneric(*Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency) Generic {
	panic("not executed")
}
func NewWrongArgument(*Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency) WrongArgument {
	panic("not executed")
}
func NewWrongResult(*Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency) WrongResult {
	panic("not executed")
}
func NewVariadic(*Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency) Variadic {
	panic("not executed")
}
func NewPointerReceiver(*Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency) PointerReceiver {
	panic("not executed")
}
func NewFieldShadowed(*Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency) FieldShadowed {
	panic("not executed")
}
func NewOrdinaryAmbiguous(*Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency) OrdinaryAmbiguous {
	panic("not executed")
}
func Small(*Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency) Ambiguous { panic("not executed") }
func Pointer(*Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency, *Dependency) *Ambiguous {
	panic("not executed")
}
